0022600019.text: The Raptors (2-1, 5th in the East and 0.5 games behind Atlantic leader... ) host the Orlando Magic (1-2, 10th in the East) in Toronto's fifth game of the season, as both teams look to bounce back from their most recent results. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard, who is out with knee inflammation and is averaging 19.5 points and 25.8 minutes per game this season, and Nate Bittle, who is out with a foot fracture. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and beat the Magic 139-87 in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
